findings.original_issue: The identity maps c a and d b act on the subsequence telescope, but the proof assigns their isomorphism to phi psi. The later nilpotence argument for the full telescope is assigned to psi phi.
findings.correction: Use psi phi for the subsequence triangle and phi psi for the full triangle in all three expressions.

findings.original_issue: The proposed homotopy includes K_(n_i) and its transition composite, so the asserted two telescope equations fail.
findings.correction: End the sum at K_(n_i-1), set h to zero at selected indices, and use the least selected upper endpoint to include the initial segment in h and c.
findings.counterexample: K_j=Z[0], f_j=id and n_i=2i: the printed homotopy at j=3 gives u h=iota_3-iota_5 instead of iota_3-iota_4.

adverse_interpretations_not_counted_as_d.issue: The omitted uniqueness for the coproduct map cannot be justified by assuming the very derived coproduct property under proof.
The maps on the first two terms are homotopic to identities rather than identities.

reading_observations_not_yet_counted.issue: The displayed Ext argument separator is a period in B. M_n.
